name: Cervatos de la Cueza (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, white and blue, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Cervatos de la Cueza (two stags on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Cervatos de la Cueza; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
